title: MCSM Command Block Tools Plus
description: Adds the command block tools based off of the ones in Minecraft Story Mode.
body:
Adds the command block tools as seen in Minecraft Story Mode.

These tools can be seen in MCSM in season one episode four (A Rock and a Hard Place)  to fight the wither storm.

This mod is NOT compatible with Crackers Wither Storm Mod as that mod already has similar tools but as different items.

Adds sounds and music from Minecraft Story Mode.
